chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad narrated from Al-Mīthamī, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb, from ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the most excellent time of Zuhr. He said: “One dhirāʿ after zawāl.” He said: I said: “Is it the same in winter and summer?” He said: “Yes.”

key_terms.الزَّوَالِ: the sun’s decline from the meridian, marking the start of Zuhr time
key_terms.الظُّهْرِ: the Zuhr salat, the midday prayer
key_terms.ذِرَاعٌ: a cubit-length measure used here to indicate a time interval

ai.seo_question: What is the best time for Zuhr salat according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the most excellent time for the Zuhr salat is one dhirāʿ after the sun’s decline from the meridian. It also clarifies that this ruling applies equally in both winter and summer.
